markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (67%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Low reliability [F6], unseparated Benign/Invasive conformal set [F1], and deferred frozen margin [F7] prompt recut and deeper levels.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 67%, Benign 18%, InSitu 14%, Normal 0% | Invasive leads; Benign, InSitu trail |
| Conformal set | Benign, Invasive (90% target coverage; dataset 90%) | Cannot separate Benign from Invasive |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 32% (flagged); OOD 84th percentile | Flagged atypical input; suspect read |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 0/5 match Invasive [F5] (5/5 InSitu, 87%–89% similarity) | Nearest references are all InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 4) · context · Below-typical score (+0.40 contribution; 8/20 AI spot check) [F2] · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.33 contribution; 18/20 AI spot check) [F3] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.31 contribution; 0/20 AI spot check) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.23 contribution; 12/20 AI spot check) · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score (+0.05 contribution; 19/20 AI spot check) · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (+0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal lobules, mitoses, and necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions 8 and 9 represent in situ carcinoma (like all 5 nearest neighbors) or a benign lesion.
- Simulated composite frozen-section artifacts drove the flagged 32% reliability and 84th-percentile out-of-distribution score, distorting model embeddings.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9**: Inspect highest-risk areas (100%, 99% risk) for true stromal invasion versus in situ or benign mimic.
2. **Regions 4, 6, 11**: Evaluate moderate-risk zones (41%–45% risk) for stromal infiltration, lymphocytes, and ductal or tubular architecture.
3. **Regions 0, 7, 10**: Confirm benign lobules and tubules; review ordered recut or deeper levels before calling margins.
